title: Collector control v1
description: Body of a successful POST /api/collector, whose request is {"paused": true|false}. paused is the stored collection setting after the call; the call is idempotent, so setting the value already in force returns 200 with the same revision and changedAtMs. revision and changedAtMs are the setting's own (0 and 0 until the first change). state is the collector's state after the call, the same pattern as roster.v1 collector.state (paused while paused). While paused the collector records a gap with reason paused: paused time is never zero activity. A newer major fails closed.
